warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 3.50 + 3.00 + 2.00 (8.50); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.00 + 2.00 + 2.50 + 1.50 (9.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, A-04 and on all four elevations and both building sections. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.
Plan is L-shaped: no columns at D1/D2 or at E4, and no footing anywhere on row D west of grid 3 — the C-E band on grids 1-2 is one bay. The east part (grid 3-4) stops at D; row E stops at grid 3.

Dummy lines from printed ticks: x 1' (-1.00) / 4'' (9.50) and y A' (-1.00) / E'' (10.00) are the 1.00 roof overhangs (S-03, S-04, A-04); x 1'' (-0.50) / 4' (9.00) and y A'' (-0.70) are the cantilever ledges/projection of the S-02 structure plan, reprinted on the elevations and sections; x 1''' (2.00) and y A''' (1.80) are the two S-02 B1 beams; x 1'''' (3.25), 2' (3.80), 2'' (4.70) and y B' (3.30), B'' (3.75), C' (5.73) are the S-03 ตั้ง posts / ridge lines.

Four dummy lines are NOT printed anywhere and were scaled from the drawing (section 4 Span amendment) because a member ends on them: x 3' (7.50) and y D' (8.50) = the re-entrant eave corner where the valley and the south-east hip end; y B''' (4.25) = the north end of the lower ridge where the valley starts; y E' (9.60) = the free end of the two cantilever stubs that frame stair ST-01. Each is measured on the vector geometry of the sheet named in its note and carries its own lower confidence_score.

S-03 posts vs S-04 ridge: S-03 dimensions the two ตั้ง posts of the upper ridge at 2' (3.80) and 2'' (4.70), 0.90 apart, while S-04 draws the ridge line from the hip intersections at about 3.75 to 4.75. Only the printed post positions became lines; the ~0.05 ridge ends beyond each post are recorded on the roof-frame elements, not as lines.

z: two different levels are printed with the same label ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+5.97 and +6.26, 0.29 apart, on all four elevations and both sections). Their z_levels ids carry the printed value so the chains can tell them apart.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-04, A-04 (roof plan) and A-05..A-08 (elevations and building sections). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-03 floor plan (room dimensions), A-09 bathroom details, A-10 door/window elevations (opening sizes are recorded in the schedule file), E-01, SN-01, SN-02. S-05 / S-06 print only member-internal dimensions, which stay on their elements.
